Session reaping is working. It reaped 9 dead sessions and now only shows completed/failed sessions with their correct final state.

The fix was already implemented by the earlier officer:

- **`reap_dead_sessions`** in `manager.rs:55-89` — checks exitcode files and PID liveness via `libc::kill(pid, 0)`
- **`mash-engine sessions`** in `main.rs:86-87` — calls `reap_dead_sessions` before listing
- **`mash-engine status`** in `main.rs:109` — also reaps before overview

Just rebuilt and reinstalled. The 9 stale "running" sessions were correctly reaped on first invocation.
